test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error’. 

Adding aloe vera gel will prevent the hand sanitizer of drying out your skin.

options.text: will prevent the hand sanitizer of

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **"will prevent the hand sanitizer of".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the context of this sentence, the preposition **"of"** is incorrect.
 
• The **correct phrase** should be *"prevent the hand sanitizer from drying out your skin."*
 
• **In English,** when you want to express that you are preventing something from happening, the preposition** "from" **is used.
 
• **This is a collocation** - a common combination of words in a language - and it's simply how it's expressed in English.

Therefore, the** correct sentence **is: *"Adding aloe vera gel will prevent the hand sanitizer from drying out your skin."*
